item.title: The guitar I am playing is the prototype of the Fender Custom Shop “CNCPT” Stratocaster.
item.description:
The guitar I am playing is the prototype of the Fender Custom Shop “CNCPT” Stratocaster.

Conceived by NASA Engineer Marshall Doyle, the body achieves its beauty and strength from nickel, which is plated onto a 3D printed mold, then highly polished.

The neck on this prototype is from a Fender Custom Shop Eric Clapton “Brownie” Stratocaster, though the official “CNCPT” guitar features a black stained maple neck with an ebony fingerboard, which contrasts beautifully with the polished metal body.

American Vintage Noiseless pickups are standard, and thanks to the unique “lattice” style body design the guitar weighs about the same as any other Stratocaster.

The guitar was launched at the 2025 NAMM Show and is available for Master Built Special Orders, I plugged into a legendary Dumble overdrive special #robchapman #guitar #dumbleamps @mynameismarshalldoyle @dumbleamplification

item.title: The final scores are in. 🎸
item.description:
The final scores are in. 🎸

Slide 1 presents our Round 2 Grand Champion, 2nd Place, 3rd Place, and five Judge’s Choice Award recipients.

Swipe to Slide 2 for ten Honorable Mentions. Selected from the next ten highest final scores, these performances brought memorable ideas and strong musicianship to the judging process. They are presented in final-score order.

Every shortlisted Round 2 performance was independently scored by all seven judges using the same published criteria: Technique, Musicality & Creativity, Stage Presence, and Video Quality.

Creative judging naturally carries a personal perspective. Each judge brought their own musical taste and experience to these criteria, and the final result represents the combined judgment of this particular seven-member panel.

The final score shown is the average of the seven judges’ totals, with the previously announced NUX Gear Bonus applied consistently. The scoring process focused entirely on the performances, independent of country or region, follower count, and audience size. The final list reflects the completed judging scoresheet.

We also want to recognize the many outstanding performances beyond the eighteen entries featured in these slides. Several made a lasting impression on the judging panel, and choosing a limited group meant leaving remarkable work outside this final presentation. We deeply appreciate the musicianship and personal voice each guitarist brought to the round.

The comments featured across both slides are excerpts from the judging notes of Rob Chapman, the artist behind the Round 2 backing track.

Visit the official NUX website to watch the entry videos from all eight award recipients.

Thank you to every guitarist who shared their work with us. Your performances gave this final round its character, and we are grateful for the time and creativity behind every submission.

#NUXNeXt #NUX20thAnniversary #NUX #GuitarContest
